title: Disclose the background-compute window (BCW) on the canonical readiness endpoint

target.subject: request-triggered historical forward-aggregate background dispatch (ensure_historical_forward_aggregates_dispatched, iter-20)

vision_gap: goal.md Vision: 'the UI tells the truth about the backend's own state ... and about data jobs (progress, blocked dates, exclusion reasons, zero-work outcomes)' — covered for boot phase/crash (J-04) and for ingest jobs (J-01), NOT covered for the request-triggered background compute: no journey, no endpoint field, and no UI surface mentions it.
rationale: The owner's 2026-07-25 budget amendment makes the BCW a first-class scored state (/backtest <= 8.0 s, /api/health <= 2.0 s, window <= 90 s) but the state itself is unobservable at runtime: _HIST_DISPATCH_INFLIGHT (forward_testing.py:1202) is an in-process set no endpoint reads, so during a BCW the badge reads a bare 'Ready' while reads run up to 8 s, and iterations 21/22/23 each had to reconstruct window boundaries forensically from forward_aggregate_cache commit timestamps + logs/backend.log (one reconstruction, the '28.06 s window', was wrong and needed an operator correction in perf-budgets.md). A failed dispatch is worse than invisible: the MemoryError at forward_testing.py:714 was caught non-fatally and logged, leaving /backtest showing 'Refreshing' with no explanation and no visible failure anywhere in the UI — the exact silent-outcome class J-01 abolished for ingest jobs. Lean: reads state the process already holds; one new Data Contract value (one producer, one endpoint), no schema change, no new nav entry.

consistency.canonical_producer: app.engine.readiness.compute_readiness composing a read-only accessor over the existing app.engine.forward_testing dispatch registry (its single-flight guard stays the only writer)
consistency.new_contract_value: Background-compute activity (in-flight BCW identities + horizon progress + last outcome/reason)
readers: ReadinessProvider (existing single poll) -> top-bar health badge
consistency.precedent: iter-33 preflight — same endpoint, same module, additive field, no second read path

excludes: any change to J-08's ready/refreshing/not_yet_computed state machine or served values
ingest-job state (stays on GET /api/data run records) and boot warm-up (stays on the warmup field)

title: Bound concurrent historical background computes (global dispatch cap) — RANKED HIGH, NOT PROMOTED: owner-deferred, tracked as B-1107
rationale: Independently re-ranked highest-severity by this survey: single-flight is keyed per-(asof_key, dataset_version), not globally, so N uncomputed historical as-of views dispatch N concurrent computes; measured at N=5 this plateaued VmPeak 32 kB under the 6144 MB cap and raised a real MemoryError at app/engine/forward_testing.py:714 (logs/backend.log:76796-76808) while the process stayed honest (32/32 polls HTTP 200, readiness ready, no wedge). NOT PROMOTED: the owner reviewed this exact risk on 2026-07-25 and chose to log rather than fix it this session, and docs/improvement-backlog.md is the owner-governed registry (goal.md Loop mechanics) — card B-1107 already carries the full How/DoD. Recorded here only so this survey's ranking is on the record; the owner promotes it by pasting B-1107's journey block into goal.md.

consistency.canonical_endpoint: n/a — scheduling only, no served value changes
